blurb: Offers dance classes in ballet, pointe, contemporary/lyrical, modern, jazz, tap, acro, hip hop, musical theatre, and specialty classes for ages 2 through 18 and adults. Classes run during the school year and summer sessions. Culminates in recital performances with costume requirements and ticket purchases.
extraNote: Tuition charged monthly; $30 late fee if not paid by 1st of month · $30 family registration fee paid annually · Recital costume payments due November 15th; $120 per class costume or $155 for Tap and Jazz combo · Costume payment refundable until December 31st with written notice · 4-week written notice required to withdraw; tuition charged for 4 weeks after notice · No tuition adjustments for absences; make-ups available for unavoidable absences and studio cancellations · Parents responsible for purchasing recital tickets ($17-21 per person, per show) · No gum, eating or beverages other than water allowed in classrooms · School year August 31st, 2026 – June 13th, 2027; Summer June 29th-July 3
